steps.title: Project Setup
steps.description: Define standard project configuration with AGP 8.3.2, SDK 34, and Java 8 targeting support.

steps.title: Manifest Declaration
steps.description: Declare required Live Wallpaper permissions, the settings Activity, and the WallpaperService in AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Live Wallpaper Meta Resource
steps.description: Create xml/livewallpaper.xml configuring active wallpaper properties and referencing settings activity.

steps.title: Define Application Strings
steps.description: Configure application strings including descriptions for the live wallpaper selector interface.

steps.title: Color Definitions
steps.description: Setup app-level primary and accent colors within colors.xml.

steps.title: Design Launcher & Settings UI
steps.description: Create active scrollable settings UI for color themes, particle size, and touchscreen burst responses.

steps.title: Configure Settings Activity
steps.description: Implement MainActivity.java saving choices into SharedPreferences and routing users directly to active system wallpaper pickers.

steps.title: Develop Engine Foundation
steps.description: Develop CosmicWallpaperService.java extending WallpaperService with high performance drawing loops.

steps.title: Create Touch Burst Graphics
steps.description: Implement fluid velocity physics, fade-out loops, and multi-color particle rendering using standard canvases.

steps.title: Building Cosmic Particles
steps.description: Verify system compatibility, package classes, build project dependencies and assemble debug APK.
